name: promptlanx
description: Blocks prompts that contain API keys, tokens or hard-coded passwords before they are sent to Claude. Runs locally: no network calls, no storage, no logging of prompt text.

disabled_providers.title: Detectors to switch off
disabled_providers.description: Names of built-in detectors PromptLanx should skip, separated by commas. Any of: labelled, openai, anthropic, aws, github, google, stripe, slack. Leave empty to keep all of them on. The generic assignment detector always stays on.

extra_prefixes.title: Extra prefixes to detect
extra_prefixes.description: Extra patterns to detect, separated by commas, each written prefix:min-max. Example: acme_live_:24-40 matches text that starts with acme_live_ followed by 24 to 40 letters, digits, _ or -. Prefix: 3-40 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -; lengths 8-256; at most 20 entries. Enter only the prefix, never a real value.
